episodeTitle.en: Brandon Chu on building product at Shopify, how writing changed the trajectory of his career, the habits that make you a great PM, pros and cons of being a platform PM, how Shopify got through Covid
episodeTitle.zh: 布兰登·朱（Brandon Chu）在Shopify的职业生涯：如何在产品管理中突破极限

guestBioOfficial.en: Brandon Chu is VP of Product at Shopify, where he leads the app platform ecosystem, new initiatives group, and M&A investments. Brandon helped scale Shopify’s PM team from five to hundreds, and worked his way up from an IC Senior PM. Prior to Shopify, he was a Director of PM at FreshBooks and, before that, a founder. Brandon might be best known for his writing on the art and science of product management as part of a collection on Medium he calls “The Black Box of Product Management.”
guestBioOfficial.zh: 布兰登·朱（Brandon Chu）是Shopify的副总裁产品部，负责应用平台生态系统、新项目组和并购投资。布兰登曾将Shopify的产品管理团队从5人扩展至数百人，并从初级产品经理一路晋升。在加入Shopify之前，他曾担任FreshBooks的产品管理总监，此前还是一名创业者。布兰登最为人熟知的身份是Medium上“产品管理黑盒”专栏的作者，通过该专栏，他分享了产品管理的艺术与科学。

title.en: Brandon Chu on building product at Shopify, how writing changed the trajectory of his career, the habits that make you a great PM, pros and cons of being a platform PM, how Shopify got through Covid
title.zh: 布兰登·朱（Brandon Chu）在Shopify的职业生涯：如何在产品管理中突破极限

summary.en: Brandon shares mental models for product and platform strategy, including “shipping is a feature” and the discipline of making high-leverage decisions with limited information. He discusses scaling product and engineering at Shopify, aligning teams around crisp context, and why small teams that start small avoid wasted engineering resources. The conversation is a masterclass in product judgment, platform thinking, and developing product managers.
summary.zh: Brandon 分享了产品与平台策略的思维模型，包括“交付即功能”（shipping is a feature），以及用有限信息做出高杠杆决策的纪律。他讨论了在 Shopify 扩展产品与工程、围绕清晰上下文对齐团队，以及为何小团队从小起步能避免工程资源浪费。对话堪称产品判断力、平台思维和培养产品经理的大师课。
